title: Chris & Martina: The Final Set
plot_overview: Two tennis legends look back on their separate paths to stardom and the rivalry and friendship that shaped their relationship. As they continue to support one another through a shared experience of cancer treatment, their story explores competition, resilience, and a lasting bond.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this documentary if you’re drawn to sports stories about enduring rivalries, friendship, and resilience; Not for you if you prefer lighthearted fare or stories without serious health themes.
review_summary: Pros: inspiring friendship; sports history; personal resilience | Cons: limited review context; serious subject matter
